children: The RealReal entered into a new Credit Agreement to obtain $150 million in senior secured term loans and a $25 million senior secured revolver to refinance its 2029 notes and support general corporate purposes. The facilities, led by Fortress Credit as administrative and collateral agent, are expected to fund around Oct 19, 2026, and carry interest at adjusted Term SOFR plus 5.75%, with leverage-based adjustments. The term loan amortizes at 0.25% quarterly and matures seven years from funding, subject to a springing maturity tied to the company’s 2031 convertible notes. The agreement includes leverage and liquidity covenants, mandatory prepayments from excess cash flow and certain asset sales, and early prepayment premiums that step down over two years.
